description: This file defines the EmrClient class in the Aws\Emr namespace, which provides methods for interacting with the Amazon Elastic MapReduce (EMR) service. It contains method annotations for various EMR operations, indicating asynchronous and synchronous methods, and extends the AwsClient base class.

classes.name: EmrClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon EMR service, extends AwsClient and provides methods for EMR operations.

methods.name: addInstanceFleet
methods.description: Adds an instance fleet to a running EMR cluster.

methods.name: addInstanceFleetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds an instance fleet to a running EMR cluster.

methods.name: addInstanceGroups
methods.description: Adds one or more instance groups to a running EMR cluster.

methods.name: addJobFlowSteps
methods.description: Adds steps to a running EMR cluster.

methods.name: createStudioSessionMapping
methods.description: Creates a new session mapping for a studio.

methods.name: createStudioSessionMappingAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a studio session mapping.

methods.name: deleteStudioSessionMapping
methods.description: Deletes a session mapping for a studio.

methods.name: deleteStudioSessionMappingAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a studio session mapping.

methods.name: describeNotebookExecution
methods.description: Provides details about a notebook execution.

methods.name: describeReleaseLabel
methods.description: Provides details about a release label.

methods.name: describeSecurityConfiguration
methods.description: Provides details about a security configuration.

methods.name: getBlockPublicAccessConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves block public access configuration.

methods.name: getClusterSessionCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves session credentials for a cluster.

methods.name: getManagedScalingPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the managed scaling policy.

methods.name: getStudioSessionMapping
methods.description: Retrieves session mapping for a studio.

methods.name: putAutoScalingPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates an auto-scaling policy.

methods.name: putAutoScalingPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates auto-scaling policy.

methods.name: putManagedScalingPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates a managed scaling policy.

methods.name: putManagedScalingPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates managed scaling policy.

methods.name: runJobFlow
methods.description: Creates and starts a new EMR cluster (job flow).

methods.name: runJobFlowAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and starts a job flow.

methods.name: setKeepJobFlowAliveWhenNoSteps
methods.description: Sets whether the cluster should remain alive without steps.

methods.name: setTerminationProtection
methods.description: Sets termination protection on a cluster.

methods.name: setUnhealthyNodeReplacement
methods.description: Sets whether unhealthy nodes are replaced.

methods.name: setVisibleToAllUsers
methods.description: Configures visibility of the studio to all users.

methods.name: updateStudio
methods.description: Updates the properties of an EMR Studio.

methods.name: updateStudioSessionMapping
methods.description: Updates a session mapping for a studio.

methods.name: updateStudioSessionMappingAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a studio session mapping.
